a1.say: Let's solve Group Words by Their Letters, using the Hash Map with a Signature approach.

card.title: Group Words by Their Letters
card.sub: Hash Map with a Signature · Medium

a1.cap: Group the lowercase words in words so that words made of exactly the same letters are together. Return the groups in any order (and words within a group in any order).

lines: Group the lowercase words in words so that words made of exactly the same letters are together. Return the groups in any order (and words within a group in any order).

a1.cap: For example, with words = ["eat","tea","tan","ate","nat","bat"], the answer is [["bat"],["nat","tan"],["ate","eat","tea"]].
a1.say: For example, with words equals "eat", "tea", "tan", "ate", "nat", "bat", the answer is "bat", "nat", "tan", "ate", "eat", "tea".

a1.cap: Give every word a signature: its letters in sorted order. Anagrams share the same signature.
Put each word into a map list under its signature; the map's lists are the groups.
Let's walk through it with words = ["eat","tea","tan","ate","nat","bat"].
a1.say: Let's walk through it with words equals "eat", "tea", "tan", "ate", "nat", "bat".

a1.cap: Time complexity is O(n · k log k) and extra space is O(n · k).
a1.say: Time complexity is O of n times k log k and extra space is O of n times k.

a1.cap: That's the Hash Map with a Signature approach. Now try writing it yourself, in Java or Python!
